author: Praxis VI
title: Diagnostics (test): Per-PC variance uniformity on frozen Praxis baseline
abstract: Runs frozen Praxis MPB‑GraphFWPCA+DAQB and reports per‑PC variance uniformity, per‑batch variance dispersion per PC, and covariance off-diagonal magnitude on X_emb; prints JSON for archival.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as run_frozen
from diag_pc_uniformity import summarize_embedding

FROZEN = dict(lam_override=0.605, delta=0.12, kdensity=22, k_total=50, emb_n_neighbors=17, gamma_max=0.70, cap=2.0, rng_seed=0)

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    A = run_frozen(adata.copy(), **FROZEN)
    stats = summarize_embedding(A, obsm_key="X_emb", batch_key="batch")
    print("UNIFORMITY_JSON:", json.dumps(stats))
    return "Uniformity diagnostics completed"
